decision_rules: Keep original automated candidate suggestions and source provenance for historical traceability; overlay verified identity evidence separately.
An identical parish dedication without city/address is not proof of identity.
Different operator/institute labels for identical building and address are institutional roles; require Excel canonical identity/alias review.
All Souls Historic Chapel, Sanford, is physically separate from the parish's main church; preserve both physical-site identities.
For a current relocation, the old address remains in evidence history until Excel review; publication of the new address/pin is a separate approval.
Independent liturgical evidence is scoped to the named church, time and original rubrical claim; no timetable is imported.
No LMD-only omission proves any Ad Orientem site wrong.
